details: Global financial markets, including cryptocurrencies, are closely monitoring the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on July 28-29, 2026. The Fed's policy statement and interest rate decision, expected today, July 29, are anticipated to bring significant volatility. Traders are bracing for potential sharp movements in Bitcoin and other digital assets amid an unusually divided outlook on whether interest rates will remain unchanged or see a 25-basis-point hike. This heightened uncertainty, coupled with reduced reliance on forward guidance from the new Fed Chair, is contributing to cautious positioning across the market.
title: Federal Reserve Meeting Creates Uncertainty for Crypto Markets

details: The US Senate has temporarily paused the "Clarity Act," a crucial bill aimed at establishing federal regulatory frameworks for digital assets. This delay is attributed to unresolved disagreements over ethics provisions and state enforcement powers. New York Attorney General Letitia James warned the bill could weaken state-level fraud prosecution, while Democrats seek stricter rules on public officials' crypto holdings. This legislative gridlock is generating immediate regulatory uncertainty for the cryptocurrency industry, with the window for passing significant laws before the August recess and upcoming election cycle rapidly closing.
title: US Clarity Act Pause Stirs Regulatory Uncertainty for Digital Assets

details: Bitcoin and the broader cryptocurrency market experienced a sharp decline as a technology-led sell-off in Asian stock markets intensified, weakening demand for riskier assets. South Korea's Kospi plunged significantly, and other Asian markets also saw steep losses in semiconductor and AI-related stocks. Although cryptocurrencies operate independently, they have increasingly mirrored high-risk technology assets during periods of market stress. This "risk-off" sentiment has led investors to reduce exposure to speculative investments, causing Bitcoin to fall towards $63,000 and altcoins like Ethereum and XRP to suffer even heavier losses.
title: Global Risk Sell-off Drags Bitcoin and Altcoins Lower
